sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Tazza is built with privacy as a priority. Your health data belongs to you. This policy explains how Tazza handles your information. Short version: it stays on your device.

sections.title: Data Collection
sections.content: Tazza does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on external servers. All caffeine logs, metabolism settings, and preferences are stored locally on your device using Apple's on-device storage.

sections.title: HealthKit Integration
sections.content: If you enable HealthKit integration, Tazza writes your caffeine intake to Apple Health and reads your sleep data to provide sleep correlation insights. All HealthKit data is handled by Apple's HealthKit framework and never leaves your device. Tazza only accesses caffeine and sleep data. You can revoke HealthKit permissions at any time in your device settings.

sections.title: No Accounts Required
sections.content: Tazza does not require you to create an account, sign in, or provide any personal information to use the app. No emails collected, no passwords stored, no user profiles created.

sections.title: Analytics & Tracking
sections.content: Tazza does not include any third-party analytics, advertising SDKs, or tracking frameworks. We do not track your usage patterns, location, or any other behavioral data.

sections.title: Data Storage
sections.content: All app data is stored locally on your iPhone and Apple Watch using SwiftData. If you delete the app, all data is permanently removed. There is no cloud backup of your Tazza data unless you use your device's built-in iCloud backup.

sections.title: In-App Purchases
sections.content: Tazza offers an optional one-time premium upgrade processed through Apple's App Store. We do not collect or have access to your payment information. All purchase and transaction data is managed by Apple. Your purchase status is verified on-device using StoreKit and cached locally.

sections.title: Siri & Shortcuts
sections.content: Tazza supports Siri voice commands and Shortcuts for hands-free drink logging and caffeine checks. Voice interactions are processed by Apple's Siri servers according to Apple's privacy policy. Tazza does not store or transmit any voice data. It only receives the structured intent result from the system.

sections.title: Apple Watch & Device Sync
sections.content: Tazza syncs caffeine logs and preferences between your iPhone and Apple Watch using Apple's WatchConnectivity framework. This communication happens directly between your paired devices and does not pass through any external servers.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
sections.content: Tazza does not share any data with third parties. The only network communication is with Apple's services for in-app purchases and Siri processing, both governed by Apple's privacy policy. No data is sent to any other external server.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: Tazza is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us at hello@xemc.dev.
